# NodeSpec

> Architecture, governance and design platform for AI-built software. Your AI assistant — Claude, Cursor, or any MCP agent — connects over the Model Context Protocol and builds from scoped, provenance-tracked task context instead of guessing.

## What NodeSpec Does

NodeSpec is where the architecture of an AI-built system lives. You design the system visually — services, data stores, queues, cloud platforms — with requirements and acceptance criteria attached. Your own AI assistant then connects over MCP, pulls exactly the context each task needs (one node's role doctrine, technology guidance, contracts and criteria — never a token-stuffed dump), builds in your IDE, and reports test results back. A criterion only counts as met through that verified lane.

Everything is git-native: the architecture model, task packets and test plans commit to YOUR repository alongside the code. Changes are reviewable commits, out-of-band edits are detected as drift, and nothing about your system design lives only in a vendor database.

NodeSpec never runs a model of its own — it is a deterministic context server. The only intelligence in the loop is the AI you already use and pay for.

## Key Capabilities

- Visual architecture canvas with 85+ architectural roles (services, data, messaging, platforms, logical boundaries)
- Technology catalog: 300+ entries with curated AI context — best practices, anti-patterns, security doctrine, setup checklists, live documentation pointers
- Requirements with acceptance criteria, sections, relations, and requirement-to-node traceability
- Deterministic task packets per node: role doctrine, technology guidance, contracts, scoped criteria
- Criteria-linked test plans; results reported over MCP flip criteria to met with git provenance
- MCP server for Claude, Cursor, and any Model Context Protocol agent or IDE
- GitHub integration: model + packets committed to your repo, drift detection, auto-push on accepted proposals
- Deterministic repo import: classify an existing codebase, determine its frame, propose the architecture for review
- Self-hosted deployments for Team, Enterprise and Government

## Tiers

- Community (free, web app at nodespec.io): every feature, up to 3 projects, no credit card — your AI does the building via MCP
- Team (self-hosted container in your environment): everything in Community, unlimited projects, up to 5 users, your data residency
- Enterprise: custom users, deployment, model connectivity, and support
- Government: compliant cloud enclaves, gov-only catalog additions, compliance package builder, open-weight model support
